# E8-200 cost breakdown (iteration 3, generated by sizing/cost_report.py)

Frozen design MTOW 1348 kg. Labour rate USD 55/h (parameter), batch N = 10, learning 85 % (cumulative average factor 0.712). Prices: bom/catalog.json (quote items at the middle of the catalog estimate range; EUR x 1.10, GBP x 1.27); made parts from the CAD parts list (sizing/cost.py). Engineering, certification, flight test, facilities and machines are not included.

## How the iteration-2 USD 448 k was composed

| Item | USD |
|---|---|
| COTS bottom-up (catalog) | 270,000 |
|   of which lift motors 8 x REB 60 (catalog estimate mid USD 8 k) | 64,000 |
|   of which inverters 9 x HBCi 400800 (catalog estimate mid USD 7 k) | 63,000 |
|   of which systems, avionics, cabin list | 56,632 |
|   of which battery (cells, holders, BMS, contactors, fuses, enclosure, 0.02 h/cell assembly) | 37,468 |
|   of which parachute, propellers, pusher motor, HV/cooling | 48,754 |
| Eastlake recurring airframe (GA regression, N = 10, F_cert 0.5) | 177,911 |
|   of which manufacturing labour 2,705 h/aircraft x USD 55 | 148,796 |
|   of which materials regression | 15,575 |
|   of which quality control (13 % of labour) | 13,540 |

Double counts / basis issues fixed in iteration 3:

- seat shells, canopy frame hardware and cabin trim (USD 3,000 estimate) were in the systems list AND in the Eastlake airframe materials
- canopy polycarbonate sheet (USD 480) and CONFOR seat foam (USD 176) were in the systems list AND in the Eastlake airframe materials
- battery assembly labour (0.02 h/cell x USD 55 = USD 2.6 k) was in the battery cost; it is now only in the labour hours
- the Eastlake labour (2,705 h/aircraft) is a certified-GA regression on airframe mass and speed; it is replaced by the bottom-up hours of the CAD parts (no double count, but a different and lower basis for an in-house experimental build)

## Cost-reduction steps (each re-optimised at 20 km with all requirements)

| Step | feasible | MTOW kg | per aircraft (N=10) USD | prototype cash USD | prototype hours | violated |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: iteration-2 parts, bottom-up cost (double counts removed) | False | 1087 | 400,109 | 306,190 | 2,464 | oei_flare_power, pusher_cont_power |
| B: + aluminium HV conductors (closes the 1.2 g flare) | True | 1043 | 393,541 | 301,932 | 2,405 | - |
| C: + 2-blade DUC pusher propeller | True | 1043 | 392,453 | 301,049 | 2,400 | - |
| D: + 400 V bus, REB LV windings on HBCi 400400 inverters | False | 1076 | 389,024 | 295,580 | 2,452 | oei_flare_torque, pusher_cont_power |
| E: free optimum over all options | True | 1043 | 392,446 | 301,047 | 2,399 | - |
